summary: Tested v9 admin features: SMTP welcome/reset emails (email_sent flag), bulk user import (semi/comma/tab-separated, dedup, error reasons), mail-status endpoint + banner, admin activity journal (exams+logins+login_count), login_log recording. 9/9 backend tests pass. Frontend flows all working: mail-status banner displays sender, import dialog creates 2 and reports 2 errors with copy/close buttons, journal tab shows rows and expand reveals exams+logins. Admin seeded 3+ exams and login_count>=1 verified.

issues: Two <th> columns both labeled 'Courriel' in result table header (second should be 'Statut courriel' or 'État')
Missing aria-describedby (accessibility console warning) on CreateDialog and ImportUsersDialog

action_items: Minor: rename second 'Courriel' <th> in ImportUsersDialog result table to clarify it's the send-status column
Minor: add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Dialog components to silence a11y warnings
Note: @example.com SMTP sends currently return email_sent=true (SMTP2GO accepts them). Problem statement expected false; verify provider behavior or docs. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py >900 lines - should be split into routers (admin, auth, exams, student) for maintainability
admin_import_users is sequential O(n) DB check per line - use bulk find + insert_many for larger lists
login_log never pruned - add TTL index or periodic cleanup; also no index on user_id/at (will slow activity endpoint with scale)
No index on users.email (unique) explicitly declared - rely on find_one duplicate check, could race
send_welcome uses to_thread with 20s timeout per message → bulk import of large lists will block the request; consider BackgroundTasks
seed_data_creation: Created @example.com test users and cleaned up after tests (14 total deleted).
